## Checklist

See [docs/contributing.md](../docs/contributing.md#before-opening-a-pull-request) for details on each item.

- [ ] Code follows the project's structure and layering rules
- [ ] `fvm dart format .` was run
- [ ] `fvm flutter analyze` reports no issues
- [ ] New or changed behavior has test coverage
- [ ] README, contributing guide, or other docs are updated if the change affects them
- [ ] The commit message follows [Conventional Commits](../docs/contributing.md#commit-and-branch-conventions)
- [ ] One logical change per PR
